如果你也已經走過覺醒的第一個階段，: If you've also walked through the first stage of awakening
開始進入下一步：: and are entering the next step,
準備把靈性的洞見，真正帶進生活與世界。: getting ready to truly bring spiritual insight into life and the world,
那第一步，不再是談更多的靈性，: then the first step is no longer to talk about more spirituality,
而是開始讓靈性退到更底層。: but to let spirituality sink to a deeper layer.
把它從語言，轉為狀態；: Turn it from language into a state of being;
從概念，轉為決策方式；: from a concept into a way of deciding;
從標籤，轉為你每天如何判斷、如何選擇、如何承擔。: from a label into how you judge, choose and take responsibility every day.
也就是把高維度的洞見，: In other words, translate insight from higher dimensions
轉譯成人類能用的語言與結構。: into language and structure people can use.
這裡有一個幾乎不變的鐵律：: There's a rule here that almost never changes:
語言越中性，穿透力越大。: The more neutral the language, the further it reaches.
真正能長久影響世界的思想，幾乎都有這個特徵：: Almost every idea that has shaped the world for a long time shares this trait:
• 佛陀晚期談的是「如實觀」: • The later Buddha spoke of "seeing things as they are"
• 現代心理學談的是「神經系統穩定」: • Modern psychology speaks of "a regulated nervous system"
但說出來的語言，都非常人類。: but the language they speak is very human.
因為真正需要被影響的，: Because the people who most need to be reached
往往不是在靈性圈裡的人，: are often not the ones in spiritual circles,
而是那些還在真實人生裡掙扎、扛責任的人。: but the ones still struggling and carrying responsibility in real life.
這些人，其實不是不想醒: It's not that they don't want to wake up.
他們只是已經無法再承受「多一套概念」。: They simply can't carry one more set of concepts.
當我們用太顯性的靈性語言，: When we use spiritual language that's too explicit,
常常只會發生三件事之一：: usually one of three things happens:
1. 投射依附（你變成權威）: 1. Projection and dependence (you become the authority)
3. 防衛排斥（覺得不接地氣）: 3. Defensive rejection (it feels out of touch)
這些，都不是真正的轉化。: None of these is real transformation.
不是把世界拉進五維，: isn't pulling the world into the fifth dimension,
而是讓三維，不再那麼痛苦地運作。: but letting the third dimension run with less pain.
也許正站在那座橋上。: we may be standing on that bridge.
